prompt: Use case: identity-preserve. Expand reference waterwheel_knight into hand-drawn production game animation atlas. Preserve original identity, proportions, materials, palette, fine ink outlines: broad beetle knight, riveted gunmetal armor, circular wooden waterwheel shield, blunt poleaxe. Portrait sheet exactly 4 columns by 8 rows, 32 full body sprites on genuine transparent alpha. No gridlines, labels, text or backdrop. Row1:4 idle breathing poses. Rows2-3:8 walk/flight cycle poses with alternate contacts and wing hinge changes. Row4:4 windup poses. Row5:4 attack poses. Row6:4 recovery poses. Row7:4 hurt recoil poses. Row8:4 death poses stagger to collapse. Same sprite scale throughout, RIGHT-facing orthographic side-view for every living pose. All weapons, wings and antennae fully visible WITHIN own cell. Extremely generous gutters: creature and every weapon together occupy maximum 55% of cell width and 65% of cell height. Center character body and fixed baseline within each cell. shield arm braces while poleaxe swings overhead and forward. Distinct anatomical keyframes with real joint motion, no duplicate shifted stamps.

qa.method: Visual semantic review, connected alpha components, explicit full-pose rectangles, >24 alpha edge checks; rejected touching-neighbor poses excluded
qa.horizontal_registration: Fixed four-column cell body origin retained; complete source silhouette and per-source scale preserved.
qa.runtime_visual_review: Reviewed actual motion_manifest output contact sheet for every animation: full body, weapons, antennae/wings present; no neighboring sprite fragments; unified source scale and stable foot/hover baseline.
qa.anchor_review: All runtime entries specify anchor_x. Reviewed final rendered sequences with fixed vertical body-origin guide; no bounding-box weapon/wing recentering. Flight origins follow authored body/cell layout, not feet.

combat_motion_v7.calibration: Continuous endpoint height and rig median; uniform sheet palette match; source pixels never morphed or interpolated.
